title: The Skewer
concept: A skewer is like a pin turned around. You attack a valuable piece on a line, and when it moves out of the way, you capture the piece that was behind it.
tip: Aim your rook, bishop or queen at the enemy's most valuable piece when a weaker one is lined up right behind it.

feedback.correct: Nice skewer! The valuable piece must move, and you win what is behind it!
feedback.hint: Attack the most valuable piece. When it escapes, the piece behind it is yours!
feedback.reveal: Attack the big piece first — when it runs, capture what was hiding behind it.
